about: Controlled values for the corpus card header (references/sites/_TEMPLATE.md). scripts/check-card.mjs rejects anything else; scripts/build-index.mjs and scripts/corpus-gaps.mjs group by them.

industries.creative-practice: an individual designer, developer, artist or director
industries.agency-studio: a branding, design, web or marketing agency selling services
industries.film-music: film, animation, music and production houses
industries.automotive: cars, bikes, mobility makers and restorers
industries.manufacturing: industrial groups, furniture and object makers
industries.defence-aerospace: defence, avionics, marine and space hardware
industries.software-saas: software products and platforms sold as a service
industries.climate: environmental markets, energy transition, sustainability products
industries.education: schools, courses, explainers, alternatives to university
industries.fictional: a showcase dressed as a product or company that does not exist

quotas.about: The floor each value should reach before a wave adds a fourth card to a crowded one. corpus-gaps.mjs reports every value under its floor; a wave should fill at least two.

sources.name: Awwwards
sources.use: Site of the Day and Honorable Mentions, filterable by category and technology; every entry publishes axis scores

sources.name: CSS Design Awards
sources.use: Website of the Day with UI, UX and innovation scores; a second jury with a different taste

sources.name: FWA
sources.use: FWA of the Day; strongest on campaigns, experiments and interactive work

sources.name: The Webby Awards
sources.use: winners by industry category, the quickest way to fill an industry gap (finance, health, education, public service)
